mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 5.0% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates for future cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in employment growth signals labor market tightening that accelerates inflation, triggering Fed rate hikes and negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE falls and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth (RSAFS > 0.5% MoM) signals robust consumer spending that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 112.0) indicates expanding manufacturing output that boosts corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 112.0.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in CPIAUCSL and decrease in FEDFUNDS signals a shift from monetary easing to neutral policy, reducing equity valuation support and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises and FEDFUNDS falls.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST > 1500) exceeding 1500 thousand units signals a strong housing market that stimulates economic growth and consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST exceeds 1500.

mechanism_narrative: In a low-unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), rising employment (PAYEMS > 137000) indicates labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation and monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5% and PAYEMS rises.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained GDP growth rate (GDPC1 > 1.5% QoQ) signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth exceeds 1.5%.
